title: Mitosis
examples: What is the main purpose of mitosis in the body?
Can you explain the difference between mitosis and meiosis?
How does the cell prepare for division during interphase?

explain.say: Today we are learning about mitosis, which is cell division.
Mitosis allows growth and repair in living things.
The cell cycle is the whole process of cell life.
Interphase is when the cell grows and copies its DNA before dividing.
Mitosis has four main stages: prophase, metaphase, anaphase, and telophase.

items: Metaphase: Lined up at the middle

draw.text: Mitosis Stages: P, M, A, T

explain.say: In everyday life, when you get a cut, mitosis repairs the skin.

faq.q: What is the main purpose of mitosis?
faq.a: The main purpose is for growth and repair of tissues in multicellular organisms. It ensures that new cells are identical to the parent cell.
asks: Why do cells divide using mitosis?
What is mitosis used for in the body?

faq.a: Interphase is the longest stage where the cell grows and replicates all of its DNA. This preparation is vital before the actual division begins.
asks: Does the cell just sit there during interphase?
What is the role of the S phase?

faq.q: What is the difference between mitosis and meiosis?
faq.a: Mitosis creates two identical body cells, while meiosis creates four sex cells that have half the number of chromosomes.
asks: Are mitosis and meiosis the same?
Which one makes sperm or egg cells?

faq.q: What happens at the metaphase stage?
faq.a: During metaphase, all the chromosomes line up neatly along the centre plate of the cell. This alignment is necessary for equal distribution.
asks: What is the key event in metaphase?

faq.q: Does mitosis involve the nucleus dividing?
faq.a: Yes, mitosis involves the division of the nucleus, which separates the genetic material equally into two new nuclei.
asks: Does the nucleus split during mitosis?
What part of the cell divides in mitosis?

facts: Mitosis results in two daughter cells that are genetically identical to the parent cell.
The cell cycle includes interphase, which is the longest phase before division.
During anaphase, sister chromatids separate and move to opposite poles.
Cytokinesis is the physical splitting of the cytoplasm to form two separate cells.

quiz.say: If a cell needs to repair a scrape, which process is it most likely undergoing?
quiz.why: Mitosis creates identical body cells needed for repair and growth.

wrong.0: Interphase is preparation time, not the division process itself.
wrong.1: Cytokinesis is only the final step of splitting the cell, not the whole process.
wrong.3: Meiosis is for making sex cells, not for general body repair.

quiz.say: What is the primary event that occurs during the S phase of the cell cycle?
quiz.why: The S phase is specifically when the cell copies all of its DNA before dividing.

wrong.0: Splitting happens in cytokinesis, which is after mitosis.
wrong.2: Lining up occurs much later in metaphase, not during the S phase.
wrong.3: Cell growth mainly happens during the G1 phase, not the S phase.

quiz.say: If a cell has chromosomes lined up at the centre, which stage is it in?
quiz.show: Lining up at the centre = Metaphase
quiz.why: Metaphase is defined by the chromosomes forming a single line across the cell equator.

wrong.0: Anaphase is when the separated chromatids are actively moving apart.
wrong.1: Telophase is the final stage where new nuclei are forming around the separated sets.
wrong.3: In prophase, the chromosomes are just beginning to condense and become visible.
